help.directions:
Click or drag-select segments.
Use the dashed lines to show invisible networks.
Set speed and Apply; presets apply instantly.
Save the city to keep changes.
help.firstSegmentHint: Current is the first segment selected.
help.tooltipsOff: Tooltips are OFF for Speed Limits. Click this to turn ON.
help.tooltipsOn: Tooltips are ON. To turn OFF, use Options > All Speed Limits.

a = Auto by map

hint.instruction: Click or drag to select segments. Use the dashed lines to show invisible roads and paths.

panel.title: All Speed Limits
paths.heading: Bike path speed scale
paths.description: Individual custom bike edits take priority over this slider.
paths.pedDescription: Pedestrian-only paths, including invisible. Mixed paths are excluded.
paths.pedSliderTooltip: Pedestrian-only path limits. 100% = game default; below 100% lowers path speed limits. Walking speed is unchanged.
paths.pedResetTooltip: Reset pedestrian-only path scale to 100% game defaults.
paths.pedApplyTooltip: Apply pedestrian-only path scale citywide. No individual segment editing.
paths.sliderTooltip: Bike-only and mixed paths. 100% = game default; below 100% is slower. Example: 30 km/h at 200% = 60 km/h. Individual custom bike edits take priority over this global slider.
paths.resetTooltip: Reset global bike-path speed to 100% game defaults. Individual customized segment edits stay.
paths.applyTooltip: Apply bike-path scale across the whole city. Individual edits stay.
reminder.saveAfterReset: Reset done — SAVE City to keep.

first segment selected.

Road decals can be rounded or decorative.
A road marked 25 or 35 may show a different real value.
